magicLink.preview: Your {brand} login link works for 15 minutes
magicLink.heading: Log in to {brand}
magicLink.footerNote: You are receiving this email because someone asked for a login link for your address.
magicLink.body: Click the button to log in. The link works for 15 minutes and can only be used once.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask to log in, you can ignore this email. Nothing happens without your click.
magicLink.subject: Log in to TimeTrack

passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.footerNote: You are receiving this email because a new password was requested for your account.
passwordReset.body: Click the button to choose a new password. The link expires in one hour.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password has not been changed and your account is still safe.
passwordReset.subject: Reset your TimeTrack password

verification.preview: Confirm your email address to activate your account
verification.heading: Confirm your email address
verification.footerNote: You are receiving this email because someone created an account on {brand} with your email address.
verification.body: Thanks for signing up. Click the button to confirm your email address and activate your account. The link works for 24 hours.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can disregard this email. Nothing more will happen.
verification.subject: Confirm your email address for TimeTrack

security.footerNote: This is an automatic security notice.

passwordChanged.heading: Your password has been changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your {brand} account has just been changed. If it was you, you do not need to do anything.
passwordChanged.calloutBody: Reset your password using "Forgot password" on the login page, and write to [mail]{email}[/mail] right away.
passwordChanged.subject: Your TimeTrack password has been changed

newLogin.heading: New login to your account
newLogin.body: Someone logged in to your {brand} account from a device that has not been used before. If it was you, you do not need to do anything.
newLogin.calloutBody: Change your password right away and write to [mail]{email}[/mail], and support will help you secure the account.
newLogin.subject: New login to your TimeTrack account

twoFactor.heading: Your verification code
twoFactor.footerNote: You are receiving this email because someone logged in to your account with two-step verification.
twoFactor.expires: The code expires in 3 minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email. Never enter the code anywhere other than on {brand}.
twoFactor.subject: {code} is your verification code for TimeTrack

signupPassword.heading: Welcome to {brand}, {name}
signupPassword.intro: Your account has been created. Here is your temporary password:
signupPassword.changeIt: Change it after your first login under Security in settings.
signupPassword.alsoLogin: You can also log in at [login]{url}[/login] with your email and the password above.
signupPassword.step2: Create a project for the client
signupPassword.step3: Start the timer and invoice the hours when the work is done
signupPassword.subject: Your password for TimeTrack

orgInvite.heading: You have been invited to {org}
orgInvite.footerNote: You are receiving this email because someone invited you to their team on {brand}.
orgInvite.body: **{inviter}** has invited you to become {role} of **{org}** on {brand}.
orgInvite.body2: Here you track time on the team's clients and projects, and the manager can see the hours in one place.
orgInvite.expires: The invitation expires in 48 hours. If you do not know the sender, you can ignore this email.
orgInvite.subject: {inviter} has invited you to {org} on TimeTrack

portalInvite.preview: You have been invited to {sender}'s client portal
portalInvite.heading: Welcome to the client portal
portalInvite.body: {sender} has given you access to your own client portal. Here you can see invoices and projects and follow the balance of your prepaid package.
portalInvite.account: Log in with the email **{email}** and the password you received from {sender}.
portalInvite.token: The link is personal. Do not share it with others.
portalInvite.questions: If you have questions, you can write to {sender} at [mail]{email}[/mail].
portalInvite.subject: You have been invited to {sender}'s client portal

welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
welcome.intro: Thanks for creating an account on {brand}. Here is how to get started:
welcome.questions: Questions? Check the [help]help centre[/help] or write to [mail]{email}[/mail].
welcome.subject: Welcome to TimeTrack
